name: @cregis/sdk
description: Official Cregis SDK for Payment Engine, WaaS, and Team APIs

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && node ./scripts/write-cjs-package.mjs
scripts.test: npm run clean:test && npm run build:test && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:sandbox: npm run clean:test && npm run build:test && node --env-file-if-exists=.env ./scripts/run-sandbox-tests.mjs
scripts.test:package: npm run build && node ./scripts/package-smoke.mjs && tsc -p smoke-tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:package
